name: FAB
summary: Floating Action Button — round, fixed-position primary action. Single-tap access to the most common verb in a flow.

ariaLabel.description: REQUIRED — FAB is icon-only; accessible name is mandatory.

intent.description: Primary (lime + glow) or AI (tonal lime + sparkle + shimmer).

keyboard: Tab - move focus to next control
rules: Position must not collide with the bottom navigation tab bar — Material 3 spec offsets the FAB above the tab bar by space.4 (16 px).
Single FAB per screen. Two FABs is a sign the screen has two competing primary actions — re-architect.

do: Use for the single most common verb in the flow ('+ New shipment', '+ New quote').
Position bottom-end on most screens; bottom-center for thumb-reach optimization on tall phones.
Pair with a tooltip ('Compose new lane') for first-time users.
dont: Don't use FAB on dense desktop screens — there's no thumb-reach problem to solve.
Don't put two FABs on the same screen.
Don't use FAB for a destructive action.

changelog.note: Formal FAB primitive (was inline in nav.tsx). Round 48/56 px, fixed bottom-end positioning, glow halo, dual-ring focus.
